articles.summary: SnowConvert AI converts legacy SQL into Snowflake SQL but lacks value-level validation and iterative refinement. Datafold’s Migration Agent (DMA) offers an AI-powered, automated solution that ensures full data parity and supports multiple platforms. In this article, we'll compare both tools to help teams choose the right migration approach.
articles.title: SnowConvert AI alternatives: Why Datafold is the better choice

articles.summary: Lakebridge helps partners automate migrations to Databricks SQL, but its narrow focus and rule-based approach come with tradeoffs. Datafold’s Migration Agent offers a more flexible, AI-powered solution that supports multiple target platforms and provides value-level data validation.
articles.title: Lakebridge alternatives: Why Datafold is the best choice
